fairness_note: price-only and +weather reported side by side; cost grid pre-specified (a frontier, not a tuned point); Brier & threshold are cross-fitted (leakage-free); a null is visible.
cost_ratio_rationale: r = c_over/c_under > 1 because the costly error is over-forecasting a price that actually floors: a generator short into a floored area settles at the JEPX imbalance price, not the collapsed spot. We report the full frontier and the breakeven r* rather than commit to a single calibrated ratio.
base_rate_explains_f1_vs_auc: The floor event is rare (see floor_base_rate); a high ROC-AUC ranker still faces a precision ceiling set by the base rate, so PR-AUC and F1 are the honest imbalance-aware summaries.
